newsitem.title: FINLAND: TULIKIVI REPEATS SEES HIGHER '97 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: TULIKIVI REPEATS SEES HIGHER '97 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish stone oven maker Tulikivi repeated on Tuesday it expected its full-year earnings to be higher than in 1996, when it posted a 14.7 million profit before extraordinary items and tax.
"The full-year result is expected to be better than in the previous year, however not in the same proportion as in the early part of the year," it said in a statement with its January-April report.
It reported January-April profit before extras surging to 8.4 million markka from 0.4 million.
It said domestic construction would grow, boosting demand for ovens, and exports were also expected to grow.
"Since autumn 1996, demand has been good and capacity in almost full use," it said.

Tulikivi also said it had appointed Reijo Svanborg managing director from July 1, with responsibility for the whole group, and finance director Arja Lehikoinen had been appointed deputy managing director.
